exposure: hemolysis, elevated liver enzymes, low platelet syndrome
cohort: 9 pregnant women admitted with jaundice to the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Kempegowda Institute of Medical Science, Bangalore, between 2021-2023
finding: The study found a substantial association between intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (IHCP) and adverse perinatal outcomes, including a higher prevalence of cesarean sections.
